evidence.text:
Canonical summary
Actuary and Data Scientist with 8+ years of professional experience building analytical, statistical and AI solutions across banking, consulting and other business environments. Holds a Master's degree in Data Science and combines a strong quantitative foundation with hands-on ownership of Python, PySpark, SQL, ML pipelines, production code and business-facing analytical products.

Experience spans the full lifecycle of data products: problem framing, data extraction and quality, feature engineering, statistical and machine-learning modeling, validation, deployment, monitoring, automation, visualization and communication with senior business stakeholders. Has led and independently owned end-to-end initiatives while also contributing to broader team-owned systems where the evidence supports shared rather than exclusive ownership.

Particularly strong at translating complex data into measurable business outcomes and production systems rather than treating modeling as an isolated activity. Comfortable operating between business, analytics, engineering, technology, compliance and executive stakeholders.

ML inference workflow
The public code demonstrates a pipeline that:

1. receives request data through an HTTP function
2. translates Spanish text to English through OpenAI when required
3. loads model/data artifacts from Google Cloud Storage
4. loads a Keras model
5. loads a Transformer tokenizer/model
6. generates text embeddings
7. predicts genre-score representations
8. computes cosine similarity against stored series representations
9. returns top recommendations in JSON-friendly structures
10. translates recommendation text back to Spanish
